source: Feiertagsgesetze of the 16 states (statewide statutory holidays), plus optional local holidays documented below
note: Statewide holidays are always applied. Local ones are off by default and can be enabled in Settings when they apply to the workplace: Augsburger Friedensfest (Stadt Augsburg), Fronleichnam in listed parts of Sachsen and Thüringen, and Mariä Himmelfahrt in Catholic communities of Bayern. Dates: fixed MM-DD, or days after Easter Sunday, or a special rule. The first entry for a date wins.

holidays.name: Ostersonntag
holidays.note: Only Brandenburg lists it; for § 3b it counts everywhere (see calc.ts).

localHolidays.name: Augsburger Friedensfest
localHolidays.source: Art. 1 Abs. 2 BayFTG (Gesetz über den Schutz der Sonn- und Feiertage, Fassung 21.05.1980, text gilt ab 01.08.2013); https://www.gesetze-bayern.de/Content/Document/BayFTG-1
localHolidays.note: Statutory only in the city of Augsburg.

localHolidays.name: Mariä Himmelfahrt
localHolidays.area: Gemeinden with a predominantly Catholic population, as determined by the Bayerisches Landesamt für Statistik after the last census (currently Zensus 2022). Check the official list before enabling.
localHolidays.source: Art. 1 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 and Abs. 3 BayFTG; Bayerisches Landesamt für Statistik, Zensus 2022 (first used for 15.08.2025; unchanged for 2026 per PM 217/2026 of 13.08.2026); https://www.statistik.bayern.de/statistik/gebiet_bevoelkerung/zensus/himmelfahrt/

localHolidays.name: Fronleichnam
localHolidays.area: Municipalities named in the annex to the FronleichnamsVO in the former Landkreise Bautzen, Hoyerswerda and Kamenz; after a merger, only that former municipality as a Gemeindeteil (VO as of 10.06.1995).
localHolidays.source: § 1 Abs. 1 SächsSFG (rechtsbereinigt Stand 07.05.2025); Verordnung des Sächsischen Staatsministeriums des Innern über den regionalen Feiertag Fronleichnam (FronleichnamsVO) vom 04.05.1993, geändert 30.05.1995, Stand 10.06.1995; https://www.revosax.sachsen.de/vorschrift/4142

localHolidays.name: Fronleichnam
localHolidays.area: Parts of Thuringia where Corpus Christi was already a statutory holiday in 1994 (notably parts of Eichsfeld and the Rhön/Geisa area), until a regulation under § 2 Abs. 2 is issued. Confirm the workplace is in one of those areas before enabling.
localHolidays.source: § 2 Abs. 2 and § 10 Abs. 1 Thüringer Feier- und Gedenktagsgesetz (ThürFGtG) vom 21.12.1994, last amended 26.03.2019 (GVBl. S. 22)
